title: TAP Annex
description:
The unsigned, crypto-shreddable plaintext accompanying an Event [TAP-EVT-ANNEX].

The annex is NOT part of the signing input, which is the entire point: the signed body carries only digests, so the plaintext can be encrypted and later destroyed — satisfying an erasure obligation — while the signed chain of digests stays intact and continues to prove what was authorized and executed. A digest of deleted data is not personal data.

While an annex exists, each plaintext field MUST verify against its signed digest. A Verifier MUST treat a missing or unverifiable annex as an informational gap, NOT an integrity failure — a shredded annex is the system working as designed, not evidence of tampering.

event_id.description: The Event this annex belongs to. The only join key.

args.description: Re-hashes to action.args_digest via SHA-256 over the JCS-canonical bytes — the SAME canonicalization the signer used, not a different JSON serializer.

args_preview.description: Alias for `args` used by some emitters; same digest rule.

decision.description: Plaintext for a decision Event: the question, and the rationale or reason behind each option.
